'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Brian Terwilliger DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Terwilliger]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Day 3 is an OUT/IN change sheet (deck name Come get some!) on the Day 2 60. The numbered list below is that Day 2 sheet. Line 42 is unread. Forum (eltwigg) matches the OUT/IN pair; IN Garindan (V) is forum-only (Xerox box empty). Ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
